note: Development data only (teacher_val, devnative v3, the owner pool); no protected set was read. Every console time is a vita/a9_cycles.py estimate.

views.dialogue: tv + dn_ink + own lines that are not names (own left out for VOCR4-W20, which trained on it)
views.names: devnative 'name' style, owner-pool name flag, teacher_val name-like
views.grad: devnative's console-finder GRAD crops of the dialogue lines

development.polarity: rv: the console polarity (dark text inverted), crops as stored

selection.rule: per LM tier, the (configuration) with the fewest pooled development dialogue errors over the six models (first minimum in grid order); 2-fold VN cross-validation re-selects on one fold and scores the other

round2_3.lms: 23 LMs: order 3/4/5, two corpus mixes, Jiten shares 0-6x, four sizes (the recipes table)

round5.decoder: + every bracket pair read as 「」 by the LM

grids.beam_topk: 8 and 8 in every round; the ablation varies them at the final settings
